name: Cognito Forms
description: Cognito Forms is an easy-to-use form builder that allows users to quickly build a form, include it on their website, and start capturing entries without having to do any development.

events.d: Get a list of all forms in your Cognito Forms account.
Create a new submission in the selected Cognito Form to save the respondent's details.
Delete an entry from Cognito Forms.
Retrieve the document created from a Cognito Forms entry so you can save or share it.
Retrieve a single entry from a Cognito form to view its submitted responses.
